questions.stem: — What would you like? — Two ____ of tea, please.

options.distractor: two 后面单位词要变复数
tea 不可数，要借 cup 来数

questions.stem: There is ____ bread on the plate.

options.distractor: bread 不可数，不能直接加 a
many 修饰可数名词复数

questions.explanation: 一片面包：a piece of bread。

questions.stem: My teacher gave me ____ on how to learn English.

options.distractor: advice 不可数，不能加 an
advice 不可数，要用 a piece of

questions.explanation: advice 不可数：some advice（一些建议）。

questions.stem: — How much ____ do you need? — Two bottles.

options.distractor: apple 可数，要用 how many
book 可数，要用 how many
pen 可数，要用 how many

questions.explanation: how much 问不可数名词的量，water 符合。

options.text: He gave me three pieces of advice.
There is some milk in the glass.
I have many homeworks to do today.
We need two bottles of water.

questions.explanation: homework 不可数，应改为 much homework 或 a lot of homework。

questions.stem: — I'm thirsty. — Help yourself to some ____.

options.distractor: orange 作“橘子”可数，这里要饮料
water 不可数，不能加 a

questions.explanation: 解渴用不可数名词 water：some water。
